item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Sprout Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Sprout Lunch Menu: A selection of fresh seasonal vegetables that you can combine with a protein of your choice to create your own meal salad.

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Homebound Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Homebound Lunch Menu: Gnocchi salad with beluga lentils. Served with feta cheese and rocket in a lime vinaigrette.

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Globetrotter Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Globetrotter Lunch Menu: Moong Dal Chilla, Indian lentil pancakes. Served with mint yoghurt chutney, raita, chilli sauce and achaar on the side.

item.title: 🍽 HUB3 - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB3 - Lunch Menu: Nepalese takeover. Chow mein with a Nepalese twist, stir-fried noodles and vegetables, fried egg, crispy chilli and chutney. (1+2+8+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB2 - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB2 - Lunch Menu: Poke bowl with tofu marinated in ginger, chilli and soy, rice steamed with lime leaves, edamame beans, Chinese cabbage and broccoli. Topped with fresh herbs and sprinkled with sesame and seaweed powder. (7+8+13+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 – Kays - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 – Kays - Lunch Menu: Rajma, protein-rich kidney bean curry with jeera rice, topped with freshly cut vegetables. Served with coriander, mint, chilli sauce, raita and lemon. The dish is gluten-free and vegan without the raita. (6+15)
